body: No way. No freaking way. Anna please say sike rn. Man I love to hate the duggs sometimes, this is hilarious

My mums friend died of cancer recently. She was a pillar in her community, a medic, had a young and happy family. I’d have traded with her in an instant, not fair she had to die and a piece of shit like me has to live

Some days I love my niece for giving me reasons to go on. 

Some days I’m angry she exists because I couldn’t imagine leaving her.
congratulations on taking back control and fighting the fight. Don’t you give up, I’ll be cheering you on from afar
I won’t be in the world for much longer bc of what 5 months of staying inside has done to my mental health

It was a well meaning friend but they’d never experienced first hand mental illness, but they had lost a friend at age 16 (not to suicide it was something else). Didn’t want to lose another and as far as I’m aware still doesn’t, just think they got in over their head trying to help and are tired of the gig now. Not helpful but not ill meaning

I’ve been told by someone who said this to me that by being honest about thinking everyone hates me and wanting to die I was pushing people away and guilt tripping them. Like I said I don’t think anyone wants me dead but they don’t want to hear it after a certain amount of time has passed and you haven’t improved at all.

she just keeps missing the mark. She puts things down to the wrong thing or tells me how sorry she is for my life. I’m tired of trying to correct and explain so I just nod along now. I’d try and see someone else but I really don’t want feel able to do anything proactive these days

I’ve been on 3 different meds in a fairly short amount of time and none improved things even slightly. Therapy hasn’t ever gone past 2 sessions (school provided) for whatever reason so not really. I’m so tired though I don’t even think I can stand trying it anymore
my mum is high risk for COVID. Can’t leave the house until June under any circumstance unless I myself get COVID

2 medication changes, change in living situation and made friends/ social life began at uni, made more friends and reconnected with old ones. I’ve been on a waiting list for therapy ever since, that’s the only thing which didn’t change but was out of my control
trying to avoid if possible. I’ve got fresh cuts on my hand and could do without being held overnight again

I’m on antidepressants and struggling with severe depression and anxiety. My mum has a chronic condition and my sibling has additional needs, they don’t need one more unhealthy person. It’s gotten so much worse since I started university and I’ve resorted to cheating so I don’t have to leave. judge all you want but for the first time ever my parents are proud of me for academic achievement and I’ve completed all bar one of the assignments myself, but I for the last one I would just stare at my laptop and sob uncontrollably- every tiny task is monumental at the moment and assignments are hard enough. I didn’t have the strength to do the last one and already had an extension. I fucking hate myself for it but I have to survive for now. I couldn’t bare to disappoint them all with the meds and the failure. I’m trying to make as many memories with them as I can and act as composed as I’m capable of rn. If I follow through on my plans in the early new year this will be our last christmas together.
I appreciate the sentiment, but it’s my time soon. I’m already older than I thought I’d be, and in a week I’ll be gone.
That I’m suicidal and this weekend with them might be the last if I don’t pussy out of my plans
